svg.title: The database at migration 0010
svg.desc: Eleven application tables. users owns its data directly or through orders; the global counter has no owner. User data uses ON DELETE CASCADE. order_items.item_id and activity_logs.item_id are plain references without foreign keys, so order history survives item deletion. Item and category names are not unique in the database; the API serialises duplicate checks with advisory locks.
svg.text: Eleven tables. User data cascades directly or through a parent; the daily order counter is global.
unique per user, by the API
Order lines cascade through orders; other user data links directly to users. The global counter has no owner. Later legacy localId
duplicates are index-exempt. Item and category names are not unique in the database; the API checks them under an advisory
